# tail

Show recent lines from PPDS log files

## Usage

```
ppds logs tail [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--level` | `-l` | `string` |  | Filter by log level (e.g., 'error', 'warning'). Case-insensitive substring match. |
| `--lines` | `-n` | `int` |  | Number of lines to show from each log file (default: 50, max: 10000) |
